t: This is St Martin's Theatre, a West End theatre with a remarkable claim. The Mousetrap has been staged here since March 1974, which makes it the longest continuous run of any show in the world. The theatre was designed by W. G. R. Sprague, who trained under Frank Matcham and went on to design at least thirty-five theatres between 1890 and 1929. Eleven of his surviving London theatres are listed for their architectural or historic interest. At one time the building was owned by David Verney, the twenty-first Baron Willoughby de Broke.
